metadata.title: Deaths in ICE custody: documented source records
metadata.publisher: UCLA Law Behind Bars Data Project / Andrew Free
metadata.coverageNote: Historical documented deaths, not a complete real-time census. No linked record means not documented here, not zero deaths. Excludes many deaths after release, during enforcement, in CBP custody, and people never formally booked into ICE. Reporting delays and source limitations apply.
metadata.locationNote: All mapped facility attributes identify the last associated detention facility. Actual reported death location is separately retained.
metadata.countNote: Record counts are not mortality rates or findings of preventability, negligence, or responsibility. Do not rank facility safety from these counts.
